Standard: Blast pressure from the escape system, including canopy, hatch jettison, fracturing, and cutting systems is verified. Blast pressure does not exceed the injury threshold calculated using the injury threshold limit for blast pressure equation per (Bass, et al. 604-615). P = P*(1 + 𝑎𝑎T-b) Where P = pressure (psi), P* = 6.0308, 𝑎𝑎 = 6.68, T = duration, and b = 0.8333 Method of Compliance: Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
(1) Lab test: Blast pressures are recorded during system-level tests at the manikin torso and chest under ambient temperature conditions. Blast pressures from canopy clearance systems are measured during system-level dynamic sled tests.
